input.prompt:
ORIGINAL production asset sheet for a colorful post-apocalyptic mobile tower-defense map. Playful casual-game cartoon style, chunky simplified shapes, clean dark outlines, bright saturated palette, soft cel shading, high readability on a phone, no realism, no Kingdom Rush imitation, no copied game assets.

Create an organized GAME PROP SHEET on a plain warm off-white background. Each prop isolated with clear empty spacing and a consistent top-down / 3/4 game-art camera. No readable text anywhere.

Include:
1. small ruined blank-facade corner building with vines,
2. broken bus shelter with plants,
3. rusted compact car,
4. rusted van,
5. cracked concrete barrier,
6. amber hazard beacon OFF,
7. amber hazard beacon ON,
8. radio antenna/dish,
9. steam vent pipe,
10. sewer drain outlet,
11. closed circular bunker hatch,
12. open bunker hatch,
13. hidden maintenance tunnel doorway,
14. overgrown radio relay node,
15. rooftop garden planter,
16. flowering vine cluster,
17. loose paper/debris cluster,
18. cracked asphalt/sidewalk corner,
19. small water/sewer edge module,
20. scrap pile suitable for special-tower unlock.

No roads, no characters, no enemies, no towers, no logos, no signs, no letters, no numbers, no labels. Assets must look mutually consistent and easy to cut into sprites.
